name: What is the typical process for repairing peeling paint on exterior walls?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for repairing peeling paint on exterior walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: The repair process for exterior peeling paint typically involves several steps. First, the loose and flaking paint is scraped and sanded to create a smooth, sound surface. Any bare wood or existing caulk issues are addressed. Next, the area is cleaned thoroughly to remove dust and debris. A high-quality primer is then applied to ensure good adhesion for the new paint. Finally, two coats of exterior paint are applied, often requiring drying time between coats for optimal results.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes scraping, sanding, cleaning, priming, and applying two coats of exterior paint to the affected area.
